name: Crush
description: Pinku uses oriental fantasy themes to create the legendary story of Tianyinxian: In the Nine Heavens Immortal World, Tianyin Xianzun, who is in charge of the thirty-six orchestras in the heaven, collects a Tianyin Stone that contains mysterious energy. Legend has it that touching the spirit stone can produce two completely different sounds of nature. The Tianyin Stone was lost in a battle between immortals and demons, during which it was struck by lightning. The other half of the stone fell to the mist-shrouded Qiyun Valley and transformed into the shape of a guzheng, named Hongyuan. It is warm, mellow and bright, like the exotic flowers blooming in the Qiyun Valley, fragrant mist condenses into the clouds, playing a heart-stirring sound, like the fragrance of flowers hitting the face, joyfully blooming, fading away the fatigue of all things, and stimulating the emergence of vitality.
